title: Moon in Aries
caption: moon in aries feels everything like a struck match. bright, hot, gone in a minute, no grudges

lines: Your feelings arrive like a *struck match:*
bright, hot, and gone in a minute.
That's the Moon in Aries.
So when you're upset, you need to *move.*
A walk. A run. A loud playlist.
You feel safe with someone who lets you *flare*
and doesn't hold it against you an hour later.
Say it with me.
My feelings are allowed to be *big* and brief.
I'm safe with people who don't *flinch.*
I don't have to calm down to be *loved.*

title: Moon in Taurus
caption: moon in taurus feels safest on a sunday with nowhere to be. same blanket, same person, same soup

lines: A Sunday with *nowhere* to be.
That's your favorite feeling.
Same blanket. Same person. Same *soup.*
The Moon is *exalted* in Taurus,
the sign where it rests easiest.
So you feel safe through your *senses:*
a hand on your back, a full fridge,
a plan that doesn't change last minute.
Say it with me.
Needing *stability* isn't boring.
I'm allowed to want what lasts.
My calm is worth *protecting.*

title: Moon in Gemini
caption: moon in gemini doesn't know how it feels until it says it out loud. sometimes to three different friends

lines: You don't know how you feel
until you've *said it* out loud.
Sometimes to three different friends.
Gemini is the sign of the third house:
talk, texts, and the people nearby.
So with the Moon here, safe has a *sound:*
a late call, a voice that *answers,*
someone who lets you think out loud.
Say it with me.
I'm not *too much* to talk to.
My busy mind deserves a *patient* ear.
I feel safe when I'm *heard.*

title: Moon in Cancer
caption: the moon rules exactly one sign. if yours is in cancer, of course you kept every birthday card

lines: The Moon rules just *one* sign,
and it's *yours.*
So of course you kept every *birthday card.*
You feel everything in *phases,*
full one week, quiet the next.
And safe, for you, is someone who stays
through all of them.
Say it with me.
I'm allowed to *need* a home in someone.
My memory is a kind of *love.*
I deserve to be tended, too.

title: Moon in Leo
cover: Moon in Leo needs to be *seen*
caption: moon in leo can light up a whole room and still go home wondering if anyone saw it. you were seen

lines: You can light up a whole *room*
and still go home wondering
if anyone really saw *you.*
Leo is ruled by the Sun,
and with the Moon here, you feel safe
when someone's *warmth* is aimed at you.
Not flattery. *Attention.*
Being someone's first call, on purpose.
Say it with me.
I don't have to *perform* to be loved.
I'm allowed to want a *spotlight* of one.
I can rest and still be *seen.*

title: Moon in Virgo
caption: moon in virgo cleans the kitchen when its heart is a mess. order on the outside, room on the inside

lines: When your heart is a mess,
you clean the *kitchen.*
Order on the outside
makes room on the *inside.*
Virgo belongs to the sixth house,
the house of routines and care.
So you feel safe in the small things:
a plan, a made bed, the usual *goodnight.*
Say it with me.
I'm allowed to *rest* before it's perfect.
I can be loved *in progress.*
My attention is a way of *loving.*

title: Moon in Libra
caption: moon in libra can't sleep if things are weird between you. it just wants both of you heard

lines: You can't sleep if things are *weird*
between you and someone you love.
The Moon in Libra needs the scales *level.*
Libra is ruled by Venus,
so peace and beauty *calm* you.
A soft voice. A pretty room.
A fight that ends with both of you *heard.*
Say it with me.
My peace matters, and so does *my truth.*
I can disagree and still be loved.
Harmony includes *me.*

title: Moon in Scorpio
caption: moon in scorpio hears it when a voice changes by half a note. safe, for it, is the truth told kindly

lines: You notice when someone's voice *changes.*
Half a note. You still catch it.
The Moon in Scorpio feels in *full depth.*
Scorpio is fixed water,
deep, and *still* on top.
So safe, for you, isn't sweet words.
It's *truth,* told even when it's hard,
by a person who's the same in private.
Say it with me.
I can let someone in slowly.
My trust is a *gift,* not a debt.
I'm safe with people who stay *honest.*

title: Moon in Sagittarius
caption: moon in sagittarius finds comfort in a window seat. anywhere, as long as it's moving

lines: Your idea of comfort is a *window seat.*
Anywhere. As long as it's moving.
The Moon in Sagittarius feels safest under *sky.*
Sagittarius is ruled by Jupiter,
planet of hope and the long view.
So you need room to wander and *wonder,*
and someone who laughs when plans fall apart.
Even a kind fence can feel *small.*
Your restlessness isn't running away.
It's *curiosity.*
And the right love won't shrink your world.
It will make it *wider.*

title: Moon in Capricorn
caption: moon in capricorn was the responsible one long before anyone asked. you can let someone hold the heavy end

lines: You were the *responsible one*
long before anyone asked you to be.
That's the Moon in Capricorn.
Capricorn is ruled by Saturn,
the planet of structure and time.
So safe looks like *reliable:*
plans that happen, promises kept,
someone you never have to *chase.*
You've been strong for *so long.*
So here's your permission.
You don't have to carry it *all.*
Let someone hold the *heavy* end.

title: Moon in Aquarius
caption: moon in aquarius processes feelings like a scientist, from a little distance. that isn't cold. it's steady

lines: You process feelings like a *scientist,*
from a little distance, taking notes.
That isn't cold. It's how you stay *steady.*
Aquarius is the water bearer,
an air sign carrying water for everyone.
So you feel safe being *useful* and *free,*
with someone who never asks you
to be *ordinary.*
Say it with me.
I'm allowed to need *space* and *closeness.*
My kind of different is *lovable.*
I'm safe where I can be *myself.*

title: Moon in Pisces
caption: moon in pisces walks into a room and feels everyone in it. sometimes it has to go dark to refill

lines: You walk into a room
and *feel* everyone in it.
The Moon in Pisces has very *thin walls.*
So, like the new moon,
sometimes you go *dark* to refill.
Music, a bath, a long nap, no questions.
You feel safe with someone gentle
who doesn't take your quiet *personally.*
Say it with me.
I can feel deeply without *drowning.*
Not every feeling in the room is *mine.*
I'm allowed to rest in soft places.
